boundary_rule: extend a winning outer deep LR geometrically by a factor of two until interior
overall_rule: within 0.003 validation Recall@100 choose CLS-only memory, then shared tokens
rq15_rule: select the higher validation-Recall distinct-token memory; within 0.003 choose CLS-only
selection_rule: within each treatment: validation Recall@100, then same-epoch NDCG@100, then lower logged horizon training time

timing_definition.steady_state_targets_per_second: candidate targets divided by logged train time over epochs 2-20
timing_definition.time_through_selected_checkpoint_seconds: logged train, validation inference, and validation save time through the selected checkpoint
timing_definition.total_required_training_wall_seconds: Prepared-stage to Final-metrics wall time over all required tuning and boundary runs
